name: Villanueva de la Sierra (Spain)
description: Green field with a white triangle issuing from the hoist to the fly, charged towards the hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Villanueva de la Sierra (a lion, a tree and a mountain).
history: Municipal flag of Villanueva de la Sierra; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle from the hoist edge to the fly
